name: holevo_bound_classical
divergence_log: Classical chi collapses to mixing entropy on commuting states and misses noncommuting rho_i. There is no advantage from nonorthogonal but overlapping quantum ensembles (Holevo < log d). The classical model cannot express the chi > I_acc gap because equality is generic classically while the quantum inequality is strict. It also ignores probe-basis admissibility and assumes a single diagonalizing frame.
